info.longName: Simplify Affinity World Leaders Equity ETF

funds_data.description: The index is expected to consist of approximately 150 to 250 stocks of companies located in the U.S. and in at least three countries outside of the U.S., and may invest in up to 20 countries. The index will be significantly invested in the securities of international companies in addition to securities of U.S. companies. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities included in the index.
